## Experience
### Software Engineer, Amazon, Hyderabad (Jul 2025 – Jul 2026)
- Owned migration of an order-event service (1.2K+ events/min) from EC2 (Java 8/Spring) to AWS Lambda (Java 21, SnapStart); authored HLD/LLD; 95% unit-test coverage.
- Built ordered, fault-tolerant pipeline on SQS FIFO, SNS and DynamoDB (message groups, DLQs, dedup, retries, partial-batch failure handling, audit log).
- Zero-downtime cross-region cutover with gradual traffic shifting (1% to 100%) and sub-10-minute rollback.
- Built multi-channel User Communication Service (Spring Boot on ECS): Email, SMS, WhatsApp, PDF e-tickets across 5 travel domains; 14+ templates; KMS-encrypted PII; idempotent sends.
- Built reusable SNS CDK constructs; led shared CDK library upgrades used by 2 teams.
- Built AI on-call incident-triage agent (LLM) for read-only investigation across logs, metrics, alarms, tickets with defense-in-depth safety.
- On-call rotation; resolved multiple Sev2 incidents; code reviews.

### Software Engineer, Cytel Inc., Pune (Aug 2023 – Jun 2025)
- Migrated legacy XML layer to JSON interface between a C++ simulation engine and Java/Spring Boot backend, enabling desktop-to-web move.
- Built Java REST APIs orchestrating 15+ clinical simulations.
- Automated CI/CD (Bitbucket, Python, Docker), reducing testing time by 60%. Mentored one intern.

### DC Analyst, Deloitte USI, Hyderabad (Jan 2023 – Aug 2023)
- SQL workflows to process and validate payroll data for 50,000+ employees.
